THE M27 MOVER'S TURN-SEARCH FLAG IS THE BRANCH MACHINE'S v34. sub_2AF10's [ebp-0xc] and sub_29A90's [ebp-0x10] are the SAME absolute stack dword on every m27 dispatch path: sub_29670 (0xD9, NETHERW.EXE file 0x4DE70 `53 55 89 e5`, no locals) pushes two args at 0x4DEA3 `6a 01 53` and one at 0x4DEFF, so the mover's prologue (0x4F710 `53 56 57 55 89 e5 83 ec 1c`) puts its [ebp-0xc] at E-48 - exactly where sub_29A90's own prologue (0x4E290 `53 56 57 55 89 e5 83 ec 10`) puts [ebp-0x10]; sub_29710 (0xDA, 0x4DF10 `53 56 57 55 89 e5 83 ec 04`, two args at 0x4DF55 `50 53`, one at 0x4E071) lands both on E-60, and the 0xDB wrapper sub_29890 (0x4E090) delegates one frame deeper onto E-60 too. BOTH mover writes are BYTE writes - `88 75 f4` (0x4F85E, MOV r/m8,r8, zero on entering the +-91 scan armed at 0x4F848) and `c6 45 f4 01` (0x4F8F3, heading found) - into a slot the branch machine reads as a DWORD (`8b 55 f0` 0x4E401), so a turn-search that RUNS decides ONLY the parity bit that `f6 45 f0 01` (0x4E452, TEST r/m8) tests; the `!= 0` and signed `> 4` arms (`83 fa 04` 0x4E43F) keep the residue's magnitude, which is why the port ORs the flag into V34_ENTRY's low byte instead of writing a bare 0/1 (writing 0/1 measured mc2l22 END -> horizon 46488 and mc2l24 devs 0 -> 2). WITNESS pair 19591->19592: hydra body 15 runs the 0xD9 handler, its mover takes the yaw scan and finds a heading (code 3 = flag 1 = ODD), so branch slot 46 (f71 0, f63 & 7 == 0) SKIPS the wander-yaw draw - retail heading 1835 / rand 34811 against the port's 1337 / 62906, exactly one extra 9377x+9439 step. Sibling pair 19627 (slot 26, heading 2322 vs 1392). Landing it took mc2l24 --segmented 20 -> 18 segments (roster 19 -> 17, devs 0) and the plain horizon 19591 -> 33371; mc2l22 and the other eight MC2 takes are byte-identical. The other 61 of the 63 enumerated hydra parity boundaries take arms where NOTHING inside the m27 body handler writes the slot (sub_2A6B0 is a LEAF, 0x4EEB0..0x4EEEB, and sub_2AF10's own callees sit below its esp), so they stay the registered floor mc2l22-hydra-v34-parity / mc2l24-hydra-v34-parity.
